moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio s-wobbly, written here): Target moves 0 → 1 on tension 180, friction 12, mass 1 (damping ratio 0.45): 20.8 % overshoot, within 1 % by ~650 ms. Kit form: springk(180, 12) over 0.65 s. Site rule: jiggly; characters and stickers. Site demo: the target moves 102 px beside the response graph, with overshoot and settle readouts. Params: tension (180) · friction (12) · duration (0.65 s). react-spring's wobbly (180 / 12): about 21 % past, settled by ~0.65 s; characters and stickers.
